# Aura Oracle TG ### Creative conversational experiment ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-work%20in%20progress-8c959f) ![Class](https://img.shields.io/badge/class-creative%20application-6e7681)
## Status **Work in Progress.** This repository is an unfinished creative application. Features, prompts, UI behavior, and hosting assumptions may change. ## Abstract Aura Oracle TG explores a conversational oracle/tarot-style interface for symbolic reflection and entertainment. ## Current scope - conversational UI experiments; - symbolic/oracle-style prompts; - Telegram-oriented application prototyping. ## Boundary ```text MATURITY = WORK_IN_PROGRESS PROPHECY_OR_PRECOGNITION = NOT_CLAIMED FUTURE_EVENT_PREDICTION = NOT_ESTABLISHED MEDICAL_ADVICE = FALSE LEGAL_ADVICE = FALSE FINANCIAL_ADVICE = FALSE ``` Outputs should be read as entertainment or reflective narrative content, not as evidence about future events or as professional advice. ## Review - Machine-readable project status: [`PROJECT_STATUS.json`](PROJECT_STATUS.json) - Portfolio maturity/visibility: [`portfolio-visibility.json`](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/Janus/blob/main/portfolio-visibility.json) - Primary public work: [Hawkar profile](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls) Presentation follows the account's [public repository standard](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/Janus/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_PRESENTATION_STANDARD.md). No affiliation with MIT is implied by the presentation style.

# AURA // KEM // SET — Sealed Oracle Mode

This mode adapts Aura Oracle to the Kem / Three Kings / Set creative continuity.

## Purpose

The canonical question lives in `ritual/SET_ORACLE_QUESTION.json`. The Oracle may generate cards and an interpretation, but the plaintext interpretation is never committed or rendered by the sealed workflow. Only a SHA-256 commitment of a canonicalized answer is persisted.

## Technical boundary

SHA-256 is a one-way hash, not encryption. A hash cannot normally be decoded back into the answer. It proves commitment to a byte sequence if the original is later known, but it does not prove the truth of the Oracle's statement. In the creative canon, Set / Sun / Moon may be treated as the intended symbolic recipients; in real cryptography, recovery would require encryption with recipient keys rather than SHA-256.

## Claim ceiling

`ORACLE_OUTPUT_COMMITMENT_NOT_IDENTITY_PROOF`

Aura remains a creative reflection/oracle application. The sealed answer is not evidence of supernatural contact, prophecy, or literal identity with an ancient or mythological person.

name: Aura Meta Registry Runtime v2

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/aura-meta-registry-runtime-v2.yml'
      - 'contracts/AURA_ORACLE_SEMANTIC_PREDICTIVE_SPIRAL_V2.json'
      - 'requirements-aura-intelligence.txt'
      - 'tools/aura_semantic_predictive_core_v2.py'
      - 'tools/aura_predictive_input_v2.py'
      - 'tools/aura_5d_spiral_v2.py'
      - 'tools/aura_habitat_spiral_peer_v2.py'
      - 'tools/aura_full_registry_gate_v2.py'
      - 'tests/test_aura_semantic_predictive_spiral_v2.py'
      - 'tests/test_aura_predictive_input_v2.py'
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 * * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  registry-runtime:
    if: github.actor == 'Hawkar-usls' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Aura
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: aura
      - name: Checkout JANUS Meta Registry read-only corpus
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry
          path: registry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install streaming JSON dependency
        working-directory: aura
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements-aura-intelligence.txt
      - name: Compile and run Aura v2 tests
        working-directory: aura
        run: |
          python -m py_compile tools/aura_semantic_predictive_core_v2.py tools/aura_predictive_input_v2.py tools/aura_5d_spiral_v2.py tools/aura_habitat_spiral_peer_v2.py tools/aura_full_registry_gate_v2.py
          python -m unittest -v tests/test_aura_semantic_predictive_spiral_v2.py tests/test_aura_predictive_input_v2.py
      - name: Run fail-closed full Meta Registry gate
        id: gate
        working-directory: aura
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          mkdir -p runtime
          python tools/aura_full_registry_gate_v2.py ../registry/data --db runtime/aura_meta.sqlite3 --receipt runtime/full-registry-receipt.json
      - name: Persist PASS or REJECT receipt into Aura
        if: always()
        working-directory: aura
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test -f runtime/full-registry-receipt.json || python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          Path('runtime').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          Path('runtime/full-registry-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'schema':'janus.aura.full_meta_registry.gate_receipt.v2',
            'status':'REJECT_GATE_DID_NOT_EMIT_RECEIPT',
            'github_actor':os.environ.get('GITHUB_ACTOR'),
            'github_run_id':os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID'),
            'source_commit':os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'),
            'registry_write_performed':False,
            'world_truth':False
          },indent=2)+'\n')
          PY
          mkdir -p receipts
          cp runtime/full-registry-receipt.json receipts/AURA_SEMANTIC_PREDICTIVE_V2_LATEST.json
          git config user.name "janus-aura-bot"
          git config user.email "janus-aura-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add receipts/AURA_SEMANTIC_PREDICTIVE_V2_LATEST.json
          git commit -m "Receipt: Aura full Meta Registry gate v2" || exit 0
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
      - name: Upload local Aura index and traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: AURA-SEMANTIC-PREDICTIVE-V2-FULL-REGISTRY
          path: aura/runtime/
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce final gate status
        working-directory: aura
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('runtime/full-registry-receipt.json').read_text())
          if not str(r.get('status','')).startswith('PASS_'):
              raise SystemExit('FULL_META_REGISTRY_GATE_REJECTED: '+str(r))
          PY
